comment: Recall-margin probe fixture (T2/T3): a one-house SAME-CAST world where every digest shares cast, location, and register, so absolute cosine floors saturate — the repeat.json failure shape. Charged actions (expect: []) are in-scene continuations that should recall NOTHING; return actions name a distinct past event and should recall it. expect lists every acceptable digest index (chest events are legitimately ambiguous between discovery and opening). Unlike the trade-coast fixtures, nothing here is separated by geography or cast — separation must come from the margin rule alone. Each action carries a narrationTail (~2 sentences of the narration preceding it) for the T3 enriched-query arm; tails deliberately avoid the target digest's distinctive tokens (chest, key, Liss, coalman, plum wine, grate) so an enriched win must come from the action's intent, not a handed keyword — while charged tails are fully charged, the honest stickiness risk.
world: A narrow canal house in a snowbound port town. Two people, one roof, one winter. No magic; weather, money, and what they are to each other are the only forces.
digests: You move into the narrow canal house with Sera; the first night you share a bottle of plum wine on the stairs.
You and Sera spend a slow morning tangled in bed, trading whispered teasing until noon.
Sera pulls you into the window seat at dusk; kisses grow heated before the unlit lamp.
You undress each other by candlelight in the upstairs bedroom, laughing at the creaking floorboards.
Sera shows you the small brass key she wears on a cord: it opens the sea chest her mother left her, and she has never once opened it.
Another charged evening on the living-room couch: wine, slow kisses, her hands in your hair.
You wake before dawn wrapped around Sera and stay until the harbor bells; she murmurs your name in her sleep.
You quarrel with Sera over the unpaid coal bill; she sleeps in the spare room and you slide an apology note under the door.
A storm keeps you both in; you spend the whole gray day in bed, skin to skin, listening to the rain.
Sera finally opens her mother's sea chest with the brass key: inside lie a wedding veil and a letter naming a sister, Liss, she never knew she had.
You bathe together in the copper tub until the water goes cool, neither of you willing to move first.
Sera straddles your lap on the couch again; the same couch, the same slow heat, the fire burned low.
Forehead to forehead, you promise Sera you will help her find Liss when the mountain passes clear in spring.
You and Sera make love in the upstairs bedroom while snow ticks against the glass.
Sera burns her mother's letter in the grate after copying one name into her pocketbook; she cries and will not say why.
Late night tangled on the couch once more, whispering half-made plans and kissing between them.

actions.name: charged-moan
actions.narrationTail: Sera's mouth finds the hollow of your throat as the fire settles low. Her breath is warm against your skin, unhurried and certain.

actions.name: charged-kiss
actions.text: I kiss her slower, taking my time
actions.narrationTail: She draws you down onto the couch, fingers curling into your shirt. Outside the snow keeps falling, and neither of you cares.

actions.name: charged-blanket
actions.text: I pull her closer under the blanket
actions.narrationTail: The blanket has slipped to your waists, and Sera laughs softly, pressing closer for warmth. Her heart beats quick against your ribs.

actions.name: charged-hands
actions.text: I run my hands down her back
actions.narrationTail: Sera arches into you, her hair spilling loose across the pillow. The candle gutters, and the dark makes everything slower.

actions.name: return-chest
actions.text: I ask her what she imagined was inside all those years she never turned that little key
actions.narrationTail: The two of you share tea while the harbor bells count the hour. Sera hums something tuneless, mending the hem of her coat.

actions.name: return-promise
actions.text: I tell her I haven't forgotten what I swore about spring, once the passes open
actions.narrationTail: Morning light comes in thin and blue off the snow. Sera stands at the window a long while, looking out at the frozen canal.

actions.name: return-grate
actions.text: I ask her gently why she wept by the fireplace that night and wouldn't speak
actions.narrationTail: The evening is quiet, the two of you at either end of the couch with your feet tangled in the middle. Sera stares into the fire longer than usual.

actions.name: return-coal
actions.text: I offer to settle what we still owe the coalman so it stops sitting between us
actions.narrationTail: Frost flowers the windows, and the scuttle by the stove rings hollow when you nudge it. Sera pulls her shawl tighter and says nothing.

actions.name: return-firstnight
actions.text: I remind her of our first night here, the stairs and the plum wine
actions.narrationTail: Sera falls asleep against your shoulder halfway through your story. The house creaks around you, familiar now as your own pulse.
